question: Is there a discount code or a good deal on the Baseus Blade H1 power bank right now?
query: Baseus Blade H1 power bank discount code sale October 2026

rec.answer:

- **Best reported deal:** Slickdeals posted the **Baseus Blade H1 20,000mAh/100W** for **$39.49 with free shipping**, using code **`Z6J1ANOV`** at Amazon checkout ($89.99 minus $50.50). The post is dated **October 17, 2026** and warns that the code may not work consistently or may be one-time use. [Deal details](https://slickdeals.net/f/20172525-baseus-blade-h1-20000mah-4-port-up-to-100w-slim-power-bank-w-usb-c-cable-39-50-free-s-h)
- **Official-store fallback:** Baseus lists it **in stock at $89.99**, down from $99.99—**10% off, no code needed**. Its Halloween sale shows the same price. [Baseus product page](https://www.baseus.com/products/blade-h1-digital-display-power-bank-20000mah-100w)
- **Extra Baseus coupons:** A product-specific tracker reports that none of the Baseus-store codes it tested applied to this model, with its last cart test on **October 25**. Generic “sitewide” coupon listings therefore aren’t reliable for this item. [Source](https://dealectric.com/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah)

**My recommendation:** Try `Z6J1ANOV` on Amazon while logged in, and verify the final price before paying. If it fails, I’d consider waiting rather than paying $89.99, given the recent roughly $40 deal.
